name: Nova's Ship
source:
Hello, I'm Nova! Your trusty ship navigator! As a sea spirit, it is my duty to ensure you have a safe journey while at sea! 

Join us as Captain Drake, on an adventure to conquer the waves and evade monsters. Together, we can help The Order seal the greatest evil and put it to sleep! 

[From [url=https://azufx.itch.io/novas-ship]itch.io[/url]]
